song.title: Abide
song.lyrics:
[V1] For my waking breath for my daily bread I depend on You, I depend on You For the sun to rise for my sleep at night I depend on You, I depend on You
[C1] You're the way the truth and the life You're the well that never runs dry I'm the branch and You are the vine Draw me close and teach me to abide
[V2] Where the Spirit leads as I'm following I depend on You, I depend on You For the victories still in front of me I depend on You, I depend on You
[V3] You're the way the truth and the life You're the well that never runs dry I'm the branch and You are the vine Draw me close and teach me to abide
[B1] Be my strength my song in the night Be my all my treasure my prize I am Yours forever Your mine Draw me close and teach me to abide
[V4] When I pass through death as I enter rest I depend on You, I depend on You For eternal life to be raised with Christ I depend on You, I depend on You
[B2] Be my strength my song in the night Be my all my treasure my prize I am Yours forever Your mine Draw me close and teach me to abide
[B3] I depend on You, I depend on You I depend on You, I depend on You
